a.store_status: iOS live (listed 2026-04-24, Apple approved 2026-04-27). Android live, confirmed by Benedict and verified 2026-07-30 (DAL-229).
a.pricing_model: freemium: 30 plants free. Pro = ONE-TIME purchase (unlimited plants, multiple locations, reminders, bulk ops), NOT a subscription. Cloud backup is a SEPARATE auto-renewing yearly subscription requiring Pro, and is the only recurring product. Never describe Pro as a subscription or list cloud backup as a Pro feature.

prices_aud.verified: 2026-07-30 (DAL-225) from both live listings. Play shows '$9.99 - $39.99 per item', so iOS and Android are at price parity.

store_metrics.note: 0 ratings on both stores, so Apple displays no star rating at all. DEC-237 treats this as the binding constraint on conversion, ahead of the price level.

a.pricing_analysis: DEC-237 / DAL-225 (2026-07-30): $39.99 one-time is ~1 year of a category subscription (Grove $39.99/yr, Croppa $36/yr, FruitForest $49.99/yr, Planta $69.99/yr) and Planter sells lifetime at exactly $39.99, so the level is defensible. Do NOT cut the price: at 43 MAU, 0 sales is the expected result at any price (43 x 2% = 0.9), and a 30-plant free tier means almost nobody sees the paywall. Revisit price only once paywall views clear ~200/month.

competitors_direct.note: Fruit-tree-specific competition now EXISTS. Two of these launched after Treesmith. All are on 0 ratings, so social proof is winnable ground nobody holds.
apps: Fruit Tree Tracker: Grove (launched 2026-06-28, 0 ratings, 5 trees free, $39.99/yr or $4.99/mo) - tracks species, variety, rootstock, planting date, age, pollinators, harvest. Outranks us on 'fruit tree tracker'.
Rootstock: Seed & Plant Log (launched 2026-07-17, 0 ratings, free in early release) - seed provenance and crosses, for seed savers and hobbyist breeders.
FruitForest: Orchard Mapping (2023, 0 ratings, 10 trees free + 1mo trial, $49.99-$99.99/yr) - orchard GPS mapping, cloud sync, team collaboration.
Trees Diary (2015, 0 ratings, $1.99 paid up front) - per-tree profiles, varieties, map, multi-year history. The cheap counter-anchor, and 0 ratings after 11 years shows cheap does not win.
Croppa (Australian, 2025-06, 13 ratings, $36/yr, 7-day trial) - vegetable focus, AU planting zones, very actively shipped.

a.aso_findings: DAL-225 (2026-07-30): ranked #1 for 'graft tracker', 'grafting tracker', 'treesmith'. Ranked NOWHERE for 'plant tracker', 'garden journal', 'plant journal', 'plant inventory', 'plant collection tracker', 'fruit tree journal', 'orchard journal'. Bare 'graft'/'grafting' returns 33-35 building games out of 48 results because Apple fuzzy-matches graft to craft. Graft is the right thing to be BETTER at and the wrong thing to be FOUND by: keep it in the description, move subtitle and keyword field onto searched terms.

funnel_from_treestock.audit: DAL-218: /treesmith.html took 12 unique visitors/month out of treestock's 2,865 (0.4%).
funnel_from_treestock.fixed_2026_07_30: DEC-239 / DAL-219 + DAL-222. The homepage (225 visitors/mo, the top page) had NO Treesmith CTA: the promo block was wired into six page builders but never build-dashboard.py. Now renders as the last block inside <main>, after the subscribe box and its highlights, on the homepage and category landing pages. /treesmith.html now uses Apple's and Google's official badge artwork (served locally from /treesmith/, trademark attribution added) instead of plain text buttons, and links the /au/ storefront instead of /us/.
funnel_from_treestock.instrumentation: Every promo surface tags a distinct utm_content: homepage, landing, species, variety, rootstock. DAL-218 could only see an undifferentiated total. Re-measure in ~4 weeks: DAL-241.
funnel_from_treestock.expectation: Deliberately modest. The homepage block removes a zero rather than being a growth lever, and the badge CTR gain is capped by the page receiving 12 visitors/month. Per DEC-239 the binding constraint is upstream of the funnel, not in it.
funnel_from_treestock.drip_email: DEC-240 / DAL-173: tools/scrapers/send_treesmith_intro.py mails the Treesmith intro to each NEW treestock subscriber 7 days after signup, once only (data/treesmith_intro_sends.json). Nightly cron at 23:30 UTC. It is a logged no-op until /opt/dale/data/treesmith-intro-enabled exists: Benedict approves the copy first (proof-of-concept sent to him 2026-07-30). DRIP_START_DATE 2026-07-30 excludes the 13 existing subscribers, who belong to the separate one-time broadcast DAL-221. utm_content=intro_email on the landing link.
funnel_from_treestock.measured_2026_07_30: DEC-241 / DAL-241. The bottom of the funnel, never measured before: over 6 months treestock produced 1,516 outbound clicks, of which 3 went to treesmith.app and 0 to either app store. In the last 30 days: 14 visitors reached /treesmith.html, 1 clicked apps.apple.com, 0 clicked play.google.com, against 639 visitors who clicked through to a nursery. DAL-218 measured the TOP of the funnel (/treesmith.html pageviews); the outbound goal measures the bottom and says the pass-through is ~0%. Adding CTAs upstream multiplies by zero. Cause is audience intent, not CTA placement: treestock visitors are mid-errand buyers, not app shoppers.
funnel_from_treestock.status: DEMOTED from strategy to decoration (DEC-241). The cross-promo stays because it is honest and free, but no new treestock->Treesmith funnel tickets until DAL-241's August re-measure shows whether ANY surface produces a store click. If it is still 0-1, stop.

outbound_referral.measured: 2026-07-30 (DEC-241) from Plausible's Outbound Link: Click goal, which treestock_layout.py:36 has recorded since launch and nobody had queried in 126 days.
outbound_referral.outbound_rate: 20% of all visitors click through to a nursery. A very high referral rate; the site works as a shopping utility.
outbound_referral.affiliate_programs: All 27 nurseries probed (guessed paths + homepage fingerprints for GoAffPro, Refersion, UpPromote, Tapfiliate, ShareASale, Commission Factory, Impact, Awin, others). EXACTLY ONE has a self-serve program: Primal Fruits Perth (GoAffPro, branded 'Primal Club'), worth 33 clicks/mo (~$0.55/mo). Ladybird and Daleys, a third of all outbound clicks, have none. A first impact.com fingerprint on Ross Creek did not reproduce and is treated as a false positive.
outbound_referral.monetisation_ceiling: If every nursery paid a referral fee: ~$21/mo at 3% conversion / $70 order / 8% commission; ~$62/mo on generous assumptions (5% / $100 / 10%). Does NOT reach $100/mo at today's traffic; reaches it at roughly double.
